description:
This two-bedroom apartment is for sale in Leicester city centre, offering accommodation in good condition with a large open plan kitchen/living area. The layout suits buyers seeking practical city living within easy reach of amenities.

Situated in Leicester, the property is well placed for access to the city’s shopping streets, restaurants and cafés, including those around the Highcross and Haymarket areas. Green space can be enjoyed at nearby Castle Gardens and along the River Soar.

Public transport connections are convenient, with Leicester railway station within reach, providing direct services to London St Pancras in around 1 hour 10 minutes, as well as routes to Nottingham, Derby and Birmingham. Local bus routes offer frequent services across the city and surrounding areas.

This apartment may appeal to purchasers looking for a well-located base in Leicester with straightforward access to both the city centre and wider regional transport links.
